programme.desc: From skunks to sea cucumbers, nature is full of creatures that deploy foul smells or sticky substances to escape danger These tactics often turn predators away instantly

programme.title: Safari Flix
programme.desc: Safari Flix is hosted by an experienced rangerguide who provides compelling in-the-moment narration on the action as it happens Not only will viewers marvel at the incredible wildlife sightings featured in the show, but so too will they be exposed to a wealth of information on the animals in particular and the African bush and pressing environmental matters in general

programme.title: Super Senses
programme.desc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by And yet, while it’s widely known that, for example, a dog’s sense of smell is dozens of times more acute than humans’, or that goats have close on a 360 degree field of vision, there’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation Call it extra-sensory perception – animal abilities we can’t entirely explain but which leave us wondering - and in awe

programme.desc: It has been believed that shark attacks are a result of mistaken identity; sharks mistake humans for other fish But can sharks really not tell the difference?

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #3
programme.desc: 米格爾幫助強尼在網上宣傳眼鏡蛇道場。丹尼爾同意在萬聖節舞會上擔任監護人,以便可以看顧女兒。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #4
programme.desc: 羅比與父親關係緊張。強尼因米格爾受傷而計畫關閉眼鏡蛇道場。薩曼莎和凱勒的關係跌至谷底。被破壞的廣告板讓丹尼爾繃緊。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #5
programme.desc: 眼鏡蛇道場接收第二位學生。丹尼爾有一個複雜的計劃來報復強尼。米格爾在午休時為捍衛薩曼莎而對抗凱勒。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #6
programme.desc: 強尼的道場課吸引一群不合的人,而他心懷不軌的兒子羅比則找到一份新工作。薩曼莎在科學課上結識一位新朋友。丹尼爾激發了一個意想不到的人對空手道的興趣。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #7
programme.desc: 強尼得知眼鏡蛇道場被禁止參加全谷錦標賽後跟市議會對質。米格爾約會薩曼莎。羅比向丹尼爾學習,而他的夥伴則策劃搶劫拉魯索汽車公司。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #8
programme.desc: 強尼為他的眼鏡蛇道場學生準備下一屆全谷空手道錦標賽,他也反過來受啟發去改過自新。丹尼爾還不知道他新學生的背景。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #9
programme.desc: 路易的魯莽行為逼使強尼和丹尼爾回憶往事。眼鏡蛇道場學生密謀對受歡迎的孩子進行報復。米格爾對薩曼莎慢慢失去耐性。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #10
programme.desc: 今天是2018年度全谷空手道錦標賽,眼鏡蛇道場決心取勝。羅比以獨立人士登記。一個舊臉孔回歸。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #1
programme.desc: 在眼鏡蛇道場贏得18歲以下全谷空手道錦標賽冠軍後,強尼開始質疑自己的道場哲學,並與他一位故人打交道。丹尼爾尋找正確的方式來應付眼鏡蛇道場的統治。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾開始教導第一批空手道學生,他懷疑自己是否能接替宮城先生的衣缽。在一個意想不到的來源幫助下,強尼發明了一些邪道訓練方法。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼爾全力以赴為宮城道招募新生。強尼反省生命中一些重要的關係,並以自己的方式回應丹尼爾的努力宣傳。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #4
programme.desc: 丹尼爾再次嘗試推廣宮城道,並以熟悉的方式獲得指導。強尼對克里斯的背景越發生疑。一名新的眼鏡蛇道場學生挑戰米格爾並與艾莎成為朋友,而羅比則重溫寧願忘記的過去。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #5
programme.desc: 丹尼爾努力幫助新生學習。米格爾交了新友,而強尼則嘗試修復一段關係。兩個道場之間的張力已達到臨界點。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #6
programme.desc: 丹尼爾的學生們上了如何克服怨恨的一課。強尼離開道場一段時間,而克里斯則發揮他的影響力。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #7
programme.desc: 為了讓學生們做好準備,丹尼爾嘗試一些新的訓練方法。米格爾活學活用。強尼做出一個影響眼鏡蛇道場既艱難但關鍵的決定。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #8
programme.desc: 丹尼爾努力與阿曼達修補關係,而強尼則打開約會應用程式的大門。米格爾、薩曼莎、羅比和朵利的相遇讓事情變得複雜起來。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #9
programme.desc: 強尼小心翼翼地嘗試不大會成功的戀愛,而丹尼爾和阿曼達則享受浪漫的約會夜。嘗試讓兩個道場的學生聚會卻適得其反,青少年間的敵意不斷升級。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #10
programme.desc: 這是西谷高中開學的第一天,但​​兩個道場之間的張力並沒有隨著夏天的結束而緩和。丹尼爾和強尼之間的競爭到了白熱化階段。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #1
programme.desc: 米格爾命懸一線,羅比失蹤。丹尼爾與強尼名譽掃地,社區仍為「西谷高中大亂鬥」的後續動盪不安。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾與強尼放下成見,聯手尋找羅比。米格爾的康復之路充滿未知,克里斯試圖召回托莉重返道館。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼爾的事業因形象受損而陷入低潮,並收到收購提議;強尼四處籌錢,為米格爾的手術奔走。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #4
programme.desc: 丹尼爾前往日本洽談重要會議,重回沖繩,尋找能讓事業與人生重回正軌的啟示。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #5
programme.desc: 在沖繩,丹尼爾重逢舊友與舊敵,意外獲得新的領悟。同時,兩大道館的宿怨持續升溫。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #6
programme.desc: 米格爾幫助強尼打造完美的社交媒體形象;克里斯積極招募新成員,丹尼爾與阿曼達試圖關閉眼鏡蛇道館。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #7
programme.desc: 丹尼爾陪伴受創的珊,修復父女關係。強尼計劃成立新道館,卻苦於想不到一個酷炫的名字。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #8
programme.desc: 得知本年度全谷空手道大賽被取消後,三位師父齊聚市議會,努力爭取比賽繼續舉行。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #9
programme.desc: 聖誕節將至,愛情與和解的氣息瀰漫。丹尼爾與米格爾找到共同點,眼鏡蛇學徒展開一場秘密行動。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #10
programme.desc: 聖誕派對上舊傷復發、恩怨再起。克里斯的學生發動暴力襲擊,新的背叛與同盟由此誕生。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #1
programme.desc: 強尼與丹尼爾合併道館,但彼此截然不同的教學風格立刻產生衝突。克里斯試圖說服一名前搭檔重返眼鏡蛇道館。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #2
programme.desc: 強尼學習防守策略,丹尼爾則嘗試主動進攻。阿曼達直面托莉。新來的肯尼在學校遭到霸凌。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #3
programme.desc: 在羅比的鼓勵下,肯尼試圖成為眼鏡蛇道館的學生;同時,強尼鼓勵珊相信自己,勇敢踏出一步。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #4
programme.desc: 克里斯將泰瑞帶回眼鏡蛇道館,但這位舊夥伴並不想重蹈覆轍。強尼對丹尼爾指導米格爾感到心生嫉妒。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #5
programme.desc: 當強尼與丹尼爾同意進行一場「勝者全拿」的師父對決時,他們的道館——以及脆弱的同盟——瀕臨瓦解。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #6
programme.desc: 即將到來的比賽規則出現重大變動,強尼急忙為「鷹牙道館」尋找新學員。托莉不得不向拉魯索一家請求幫助。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #7
programme.desc: 丹尼爾邀請安東尼加入宮城道,卻發現自己其實並不如想像中了解兒子。米格爾得知強尼與卡門之間的真相。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #8
programme.desc: 米格爾與珊期待參加青少年舞會,卻因另一對情侶的突然出現而生變。泰瑞將強尼引誘至一個熟悉的地方。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #9
programme.desc: 一年一度的全谷空手道大賽正式展開,多個道館為總冠軍而戰,同時清算私人恩怨。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #10
programme.desc: 比賽以震撼結局落幕,後續影響讓所有參賽者措手不及,兩位冠軍的未來充滿變數。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #1
programme.desc: 丹尼爾的新盟友(後轉為室友)考驗著阿曼達的耐心。米格爾在墨西哥尋找親生父親。泰瑞則開始對「眼鏡蛇道館」進行大改造。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #2
programme.desc: 喬善和丹尼爾策劃了一個針對泰瑞的冒險計畫。在墨西哥,羅比和強尼正在尋找米格爾,而米格爾發現了關於他父親的真相。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼爾過去的另一個敵人重新浮出水面。經過一天的 SPA 水療和一番內心掙扎後,珊對於她與米格爾的未來做出了決定。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #4
programme.desc: 強尼和卡門的情事進展順利,而丹尼爾和阿曼達則被泰瑞的陰謀搞得心神不寧。青少年們的恩怨延燒到了水上樂園。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #5
programme.desc: 丹尼爾依靠一位朋友——也是「亦敵亦友」的夥伴。米格爾和羅比的緊張關係達到頂點。一張熟悉的面孔回歸了。

programme.title: 塞斯梅耶斯深夜秀 13 #76
programme.desc: 《塞斯梅耶斯深夜秀》由艾美獎得主洛恩米高斯監製,邀請一線紅星作嘉賓,還有難忘的喜劇和最棒的音樂人。

programme.title: 吉米法倫今夜秀 13 #89
programme.desc: 艾美獎及格林美獎得主兼喜劇演員吉米法倫以好客的訪問風格、觀眾投入度、精準的模仿和創新的短劇,將他獨特的高能爆笑喜劇引進NBC的60年傳奇系列。

programme.title: 波士頓執法尊家 (第一季) #13

programme.title: 打貪妙探 (第三季) #5

programme.title: 看不見的罪案(第二季) #4

programme.title: 中年新手警察 (第八季) #13

programme.desc: 由於艾略特情緒不穩,機械人先生和達琳嘗試打倒上帝集團。拜斯與白玫對峙。白玫試圖操縱艾略特,而機械人先生則努力想出怎樣幫助艾略特找到自我。

programme.title: 黑帆 2 #1
programme.desc: 海象號船員被困在海灘上,西班牙大軍擋在他們和烏爾卡·德·利馬號上的黃金之間。弗林特即將被帶到昔日船員面前接受審判,他想出了一個生存計畫: 潛入軍艦,幹掉守衛。

programme.title: 黑帆 2 #2
programme.desc: 「海象號」的一名船員意外歸來,卻發現自己被殘忍地綁在沙灘上。弗林特仍然被困在船艙深處,他開始實施自己的計劃,打算兩天後成為船長,為此他向杜弗雷納提供了一條航行路線的建議。

programme.title: 天選之家

programme.title: 傑克泰勒: 煉獄之中
programme.desc: 傑克和達華受僱於一家大型軟件公司的老闆,查出是誰竊取了他們寶貴的遊戲數據。

programme.title: 天選之家
programme.desc: 安(希芙嘉咸飾)是一位瑜伽導師,儘管她的家人讓她抓狂,約會生活又悲慘,但她仍努力實現內心的平靜。

programme.title: 魔法水果籃 第一季 #6
programme.desc: 由希的穿搭在校慶上造成轟動,而小透又再次遇到那位神秘的小男孩。

programme.title: 魔法水果籃 第一季 #7
programme.desc: 草摩家傳喚小透過去,羽鳥醫生勸她不要再和草摩家有所牽連。

programme.title: 魔法水果籃 第一季 #8
programme.desc: 亞里紗和小咲邀請小透一起去跨年,小透卻拒絕了,即使她根本沒有家人可以一起慶祝。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #10
programme.desc: 在茜因為嚴重的感冒差點倒下時,出現在她面前的山田把她送到診所看病。椿曾在另一款網路遊戲中與山田對戰,與他建立友誼。了解山田會與女性保持距離的椿儘管心中排斥喜歡上對方,但對他的感情卻逐漸變得深厚,山田在她心中的地位也日益增大。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #11
programme.desc: 在山田的照顧下茜從感冒中康復。久違地登入FOS後,她第一次與公會新成員椿的角色接觸。兩人組隊挑戰了最終頭目,但卻因為敵人防禦力太高而陷入困境,不過一同戰鬥的過程讓茜與椿的關係立刻變得親近。登出後茜打給山田,希望能獲得有關遊戲攻略的建議。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #12
programme.desc: 決定向山田告白的茜將自己的決心告訴親友桃子和「琉璃姬」瑛太。茜無預警地來到山田的公寓,但面對急著要去補習班的山田,她始終無法說出心中的話。於是兩人約在補習班結束後再碰面,但突如其來的暴雨和椿衝動的行為讓當天的計畫被迫取消。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #11
programme.desc: 眼看圭護的運動鞋就要被搶走時監志出手幫助了他。襲擊圭護的男人利用了具有興奮作用的珠珠糖增強自己的力量及欲望。據說散播珠珠糖的是人稱「狼」的人物,而使用珠珠糖作亂的那些人則被稱為「狗」。另一方面,自稱是魔女的宮尾音夢出現在妮可和守仁面前。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #12
programme.desc: 原來真神圭護就是「狼」!他在看見三日月的形狀後,變身成為具有凶暴性及野性力量的強悍狼人,對守仁展開襲擊。在這個時候,與守仁分頭行動的妮可和監志被狼手下的「狗」團團包圍。兩人約定妮可負責搜索想對自己下手的魔女,監志則在發現魔女後展開攻擊。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #13
programme.desc: 一連串風波落幕後,真神圭護搬入乙木家。根據圭護的說法,他只要看到「彎月形狀的東西」就會變成狼人,任性妄為地沉溺於食慾及睡眠,甚至連性慾都會變得無所限制。為了降低他變身的風險,妮可、守仁、監志和圭護合力將家裡所有彎月形狀的東西都收了起來。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #14
programme.desc: 本集A part播出「混亂的海市蜃樓」第119話「討伐FUZZY-4」。空、朧、狹霧、薩克來到了過去曾進行某種研究的廢棄大樓。薩克和狹霧讓身為新人的空和朧待命,並分別潛入東棟和西棟。然而朧卻反抗薩克。這時,敵人的身影突然出現!

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #3
programme.desc: 在女性向遊戲中本該對反派千金冷感的杜克,卻莫名地對艾莉西亞這位想留名歷史的反派表露興趣。艾莉西亞雖然對他的舉動感到困惑,但沒有閒暇沉溺於戀愛的她,悄悄潛入了魔法學院。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #4
programme.desc: 艾莉西亞因為卓越的能力得到器重,於是接下負責監督聖女麗茲的任務,艾莉西亞因此得到「聖女的宿敵」這個對反派千金而言最完美的身分。她以特例進入麗茲所在的魔法學院就讀,那裡卻是敵人的大本營。

programme.title: 海賊王 #486
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #3
programme.desc: 在女性向遊戲中本該對反派千金冷感的杜克,卻莫名地對艾莉西亞這位想留名歷史的反派表露興趣。艾莉西亞雖然對他的舉動感到困惑,但沒有閒暇沉溺於戀愛的她,悄悄潛入了魔法學院。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #4
programme.desc: 艾莉西亞因為卓越的能力得到器重,於是接下負責監督聖女麗茲的任務,艾莉西亞因此得到「聖女的宿敵」這個對反派千金而言最完美的身分。她以特例進入麗茲所在的魔法學院就讀,那裡卻是敵人的大本營。

programme.title: 魔法水果籃 第一季 #6
programme.desc: 由希的穿搭在校慶上造成轟動,而小透又再次遇到那位神秘的小男孩。

programme.title: 魔法水果籃 第一季 #7
programme.desc: 草摩家傳喚小透過去,羽鳥醫生勸她不要再和草摩家有所牽連。

programme.title: 魔法水果籃 第一季 #8
programme.desc: 亞里紗和小咲邀請小透一起去跨年,小透卻拒絕了,即使她根本沒有家人可以一起慶祝。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #10
programme.desc: 在茜因為嚴重的感冒差點倒下時,出現在她面前的山田把她送到診所看病。椿曾在另一款網路遊戲中與山田對戰,與他建立友誼。了解山田會與女性保持距離的椿儘管心中排斥喜歡上對方,但對他的感情卻逐漸變得深厚,山田在她心中的地位也日益增大。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #11
programme.desc: 在山田的照顧下茜從感冒中康復。久違地登入FOS後,她第一次與公會新成員椿的角色接觸。兩人組隊挑戰了最終頭目,但卻因為敵人防禦力太高而陷入困境,不過一同戰鬥的過程讓茜與椿的關係立刻變得親近。登出後茜打給山田,希望能獲得有關遊戲攻略的建議。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #12
programme.desc: 決定向山田告白的茜將自己的決心告訴親友桃子和「琉璃姬」瑛太。茜無預警地來到山田的公寓,但面對急著要去補習班的山田,她始終無法說出心中的話。於是兩人約在補習班結束後再碰面,但突如其來的暴雨和椿衝動的行為讓當天的計畫被迫取消。

programme.desc: 一連串風波落幕後,真神圭護搬入乙木家。根據圭護的說法,他只要看到「彎月形狀的東西」就會變成狼人,任性妄為地沉溺於食慾及睡眠,甚至連性慾都會變得無所限制。為了降低他變身的風險,妮可、守仁、監志和圭護合力將家裡所有彎月形狀的東西都收了起來。

programme.desc: 可瑪莉在七紅天爭霸戰獲勝後去度假勝地休假。她與薇兒和佐久奈等人在海邊玩鬧,沒想到邀請他們的正是前幾天被可瑪莉肆虐的蓋拉阿爾卡共和國。可瑪莉預感這是圈套,這時蓋拉阿爾卡的八英將納莉亞現身。她莫名激動又裝熟,甚至在會談的時候提議聯手征服世界。

programme.title: 家裡蹲吸血姬的鬱悶 #10
programme.desc: 可瑪莉的部下們擅自襲擊了納莉亞的部下,導致蓋拉阿爾卡共和國與姆爾納特帝國的關係惡化。而後姆爾納特帝國與天照樂土共組同盟,卻遭到蓋拉阿爾卡共和國宣戰。可瑪莉被帶去城塞都市費爾,卻發現這裡即將爆發戰爭。檯面下各國的意圖隱約可見。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #2
programme.desc: 離春高全國大賽僅剩一個月。擅自參加宮城縣1年級生選拔強化集訓的日向以撿球員的身分加入。此時白鳥澤3年級生的畢業生作為練習賽的對手來訪。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #3
programme.desc: 日向・影山・月島不在的情況下,烏野高中排球社面臨與常波高中的練習賽。與此同時,至今只一味追趕球的日向從外觀摩和牛島等人的練習賽時,首次發現一件事。

programme.title: 海賊王 #488
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 海賊王 #489
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #12
programme.desc: 決定向山田告白的茜將自己的決心告訴親友桃子和「琉璃姬」瑛太。茜無預警地來到山田的公寓,但面對急著要去補習班的山田,她始終無法說出心中的話。於是兩人約在補習班結束後再碰面,但突如其來的暴雨和椿衝動的行為讓當天的計畫被迫取消。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #9

programme.title: 《聖經》實戰攻略

programme.title: 麥希真牧師 末了的話 踏實的差傳
programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《踏實的差傳》。

programme.title: 劉三論今-家和萬事興系列

programme.title: 福音電影: 亞洲英雄-沒有硝煙的戰爭
programme.desc: 自古亂世出英雄,在2003年春天的一場沒有硝煙的戰爭中,一群捨己救人的真英雄誕生了。在一輪出生入死的拚搏過後,寫下了香港杏林史上引以為傲的一頁,亦叫早己冷卻的心再一次跳動。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蘇穎睿牧師-信心之旅
programme.desc: 希伯來書除了論證耶穌基督的超越性之外,字裡行間隨時都有對猶太信徒的勸勉,因為這些猶太信徒受本族人的壓力,產生許多疑難,信心開始動搖。藉着希伯來書,蘇穎睿牧師帶你走進歷史,閱覽這趟考驗信心之旅。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 創世記 -呂沛淵牧師
喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 日日運動身體好，吳幸美竟教跆拳道學員「洗面盆學游泳」、「牀下底踢毽」？原來是為了講解「㜺鬼」歇後語。廣東道玉器街是香港七十年代的熱門「蒲點」，主持們到訪玉器店學習分辨玉器優劣，期間發現「玉器塗白漆－ 內中有寶」？農曆七月初七又叫「七姐節」、「乞巧節」，背後除了牛郎織女的深情故事，還另有文章！霓虹燈製作過程繁複，「楷師傅」三兩下手勢便做出「TVB光管」，果然是「半空中點燈－ 高招」！

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 「盂蘭節」是中國傳統的「鬼節」，善信自會備好各式祭品「做節」。眾主持前往餅店尋找「文化遺產」，幸美卻帶來探險裝備，可謂「抬棺材甩褲－ 失禮死人」。鄭寶鴻另會講解「拋三牲」、「散福」等習俗。洋服店老闆逾四十年來堅持手做西裝，功架十足堪稱「飛機上點燈－ 高明」。張惠雅還向老闆請教何謂「關公領」、「飛機領」，以及時下流行的西裝款式。「擔屎唔偷食」意指為人忠直老實，俗語背後原來隱藏自明朝流傳至今的誤解！

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 壓軸一玩，在婚宴場地玩一番，由「垃圾之最」連詩雅、朱智賢鬥倒霉抽隊員，兩人的行為總是令人摸不著頭腦。大玩隊與特玩隊進行一對一單挑，蝦頭與楊潮凱造就「同姓一吻」；陳嘉桓、林秀怡竟出動肥肉搶鏡；翟威廉與朱智賢大鬥反應，威廉勝出卻輸風度！「開口中」遊戲談起情侶間的暱稱，眾人戀情被Bob擺上檯，為何最後區永權要接受吃辣飯的懲罰？藝員搶花球爭獎品，有甚麼東西令蝦頭感動流涕？慰勞宴上，眾人分享最難忘的事。

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼離開墨西哥，進入危地馬拉叢林探險。他們開車深入帕卡亞火山國家公園，游繩降下140呎的瀑布。然後去彈奏馬林巴琴，輕鬆一番。最後去阿蒂特蘭自然保護區，嘗試刺激的高空單車。

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼去馬拿瓜市的東方市場觀光。這是中美洲最大市場，面積超過五平方公里，有五萬攤檔，每天有十萬人次到訪。他們又去和棒球隊一起操練，爭取在職業比賽投出第一球。最後更勇闖活火山。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 星夢頻道擺脫史上最大危機，閃亮宿也迎來了春天。寶石偶像每個都懷著新的目標，為了踏上新旅途各自忙碌。而奇蹟閃耀組的三人，就一邊回顧過去一年發生的事，一邊進行閃亮宿散步的直播……

programme.title: 奶龍與小七之大戰暴暴龍粵普
programme.desc: 在一個山清水秀的村子裡，奶龍小七平靜的生活被打破，暴暴龍為了取代奶龍成為宇宙最強龍，在村子各種使壞，奶龍小七為了阻止其的惡行展開一系列英勇鬥爭，上演了一幕幕只為能守每個人心中最純真的美好。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄被要求示展收藏品，於是求多啦A夢幫忙，後者不知從哪裡拿來最新卡通人物的商品。靜香的狗比洛經常走失，大雄和多啦A夢打算送「回來頸鏈」給她作生日禮物，誰知頸鏈誤打誤撞下被靜香戴上。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星團粵日
programme.desc: 眼見翼操勞過度，大黑兄弟安排她和B-PRO一起去到相熟的溫泉旅館好好休息。晚餐時發現多了兩份餐膳，眾人疑惑之際，Ultras的兩人突然來到，他們明白擅自拍片道歉做法不對，借此機會親身向翼和B-PRO道歉。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 轉轉口味，糖妹、婭溦這集來到上海的韓國街，化身「韓妹」遍尋韓式小吃。快餐車直送芝士香腸熱狗、奶油年糕湯。未夠滋味？幫襯出爐熱辣辣核桃餅與咖啡豆餅。炭燒烤肉風味大餐開動！厚切豬五花棒棒糖、豬豬星球拼盤，還不及火豚星三拼飯邪惡！大口吞下韓國的味道，難怪婭溦要點喝清腸排毒果汁。主持們換上漢服，置身格調優雅的文化茶館，在城市中的世外桃源歇一歇息。入夜，全力衝刺全蟹宴私房菜，婭溦帶來獨門拌蟹麵吃法！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 適逢復活節長假期，6號教大家自製鹹蛋；又把西蘭花莖切片，分別加入柚子味噌、陳醋醃製，成品更得肥媽好評。阿媽亦特意奉上全蛋宴，她由健康出發，以刀削麵代替油分偏高的河粉，炮製出「七彩炒刀削麵」。「三色蒸蛋」是家常小菜，但要蒸出嫩滑靚蛋也有秘訣，蛋與水的比例怎樣？紫洋蔥含豐富花青素，連同冬菇等配料拌進香脆可口的「煎蛋餅」中，吃出肉餅口感！肥媽還將傳統甜品「水蒸蛋糕」的配方改良，「減甜」迎合健康生活態度。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 有指多吃咖喱，可助腦部延緩退化。肥媽精通環球美食，這次特意準備了印度咖喱菜式，讓地道風味發揮食療價值。肥媽為「鷹嘴豆餅」加入燕麥，創新配搭有助消減色素與油分。「炸餅」期間，「百厭」6號不依烹調指示，即令阿媽「發火」。另一道「印度素咖喱」，食材份量經過重新調配，貼近港人口味。「牛油雞」用希臘乳酪醃製再焗，入口軟腍。「印度咖喱角」的餡料以補腦黃薑粉製作，肥媽還加入印度酥油原味，香脆有益「無得輸」！

programme.title: 不可能任務粵PG
programme.desc: 為呈現不一樣的仁濟晚會，除了已拍的片段，還有現場表演的舞台劇。「導演」慰玲提出的舞台細節，卻不獲眾助導認同？「撰稿」祖儀則有幸為短劇創作歌曲，別有一番意義。構思落實，開騷前幾天要進行連串綵排，「助導」百恩做事細心，獲得演出嘉賓之一袁偉豪點名稱讚。終於來到直播時刻，身在控制室的「助導」浩駿「投入」做觀眾，接連犯錯……騷後檢討，任務「發起人」曾志偉現身，訴說設立這次不可能任務的原意，讓各藝員從中成長。

programme.title: 不可能任務粵PG
programme.desc: 隊長蔡思貝帶領同是「港姐」的謝嘉怡、邢慧敏、黃碧蓮、邵珮詩、蘇韻姿受訓三星期，並參加「警隊跨部門演習」。先踏入模擬街道，嘗試協助警隊四個兼任職務：搜查隊、爆炸品處理課、談判組、高空工作隊的聯合小型演習；五隊員尚可沉着應對。首項訓練來自爆炸品處理課，思貝即要試穿重達八十磅的防爆衣！被選擔任No1拆彈崗位的碧蓮、慧敏亦要輪流穿著，並以內窺鏡執行搜查任務，但期間都稍欠定力，現場同時傳出「爆炸聲」……

programme.title: 隨懿深度行粵PG
programme.desc: 為了滿足嘉賓高海寧的高要求，諾懿安排入住雪邦的海上渡假村，擁抱無敵海景！駕越野電單車在沙灘上飛馳，「車手」海寧卻嫌未夠喉？靜下來體驗蠟染小手工，諾懿被指無藝術細胞，這次成品卻有驚喜。啤酒用來做海鮮火鍋湯底出奇地夾，料理誕生原因更與店主的醉酒經歷有關？來到馬來西亞「天空之鏡」，擺出被風吹起、打怪獸等趣怪打卡動作，好友玩餐飽。接着潮玩夾榴槤機，再享用浪漫沙灘晚餐，海寧更會近距離參與耍火表演，好盡興！

programme.title: 隨懿深度行粵PG
programme.desc: 熟悉馬來西亞的黃翠如，反客為主替諾懿安排吉隆坡玩味之旅。勇闖室內刺激主題公園，挑戰高空設施，好友互相扶持下成功突破自己！翠如事前與製作人員夾計要整蠱諾懿，結果卻出乎意料……轉往天台酒吧歡聚，翠如回想起跟丈夫蕭正楠在荷蘭飲住過聖誕。激鬥電動小型賽車，面對「唔識轉彎」的翠如，諾懿笑言擔心多於信心！享用過惹味開胃的娘惹菜，想將當地風味帶回香港？「地獄廚神」翠如學煮咖喱雞，但進度極緩慢，諾懿忍不住要出手！

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 要製作甜而不膩的甜品，除了食材份量控制要精準，還講求甜品師靈敏的味覺，從而配搭出最佳口味。阿古(古嘉俊)今次示範的「焦糖蘋果牛奶朱古力蛋糕」，透過微酸的青蘋果中和焦糖慕絲的甜膩，還運用青蘋果蓉的爽脆質感，與香滑慕絲形成有趣的口感對比。青蘋果蓉需事前混入肉桂粉醃製發酵，並經過一整晚時間的冷藏步驟，水果的清甜會否因而流失？今集請來彭慧中一同參與示範，到底她的甜美外表，會否令到阿古在控制甜度方面失預算？

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 伊奈甦醒，但失去過去兩年記憶，經過一輪盤問後，超鐵機決定讓她復職，成為開發室主任。學生會會長伽馬來到鐵路部部室，要求鐵路部交還部室，各人設法阻止之際，良太則帶同太晴去抓伽馬痛腳。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 復活節象徵着希望和重生，結他導師暢談與非洲土著以音樂交流的經歷，然後以結他作為伴奏，與主持們合唱兩首應節歌曲，發放復活節的正能量。據資料所述，瑞典有音樂家用半年時間教章魚彈琴，而本集「My Little Show」也有一名小女生表演鋼琴，她又是怎樣研究每首歌的演繹方法？團體舞蹈講求合作性，七位穿上「金光閃閃」舞衣的小女孩，拿着道具金幣，送上優雅的芭蕾舞表演；小舞者亦談及如何提升團隊合拍度。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 假冒的屁屁偵探與助手蓓朗去到柵欄監獄探訪一名叫鱷川的囚犯後，偷去其私人物品並逃走。真正的屁屁偵探因而被捕，為了查出假冒者是誰，屁屁偵探決定潛入柵欄監獄，接觸鱷川並套取其口風。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 姐姐作文功課的題目是家人，卻煩惱沒有東西可寫，有次全家出外獨留姐姐在家，反為她帶來靈感。小丸子為了得到金豬錢箱，建議小杉參加餐廳的五重塔炸豬扒挑戰，後者信心不足，豬太郎大力鼓勵。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 危機現場粵
programme.desc: 本片選取近年來國內最具代表性的安全事故和自然災害，作科學分析，重現處置過程，展現當下中國應急救援專業能力的提升和全新面貌，分析事發原因和調查過程，解讀事故隱患。同時，展示人類的勇氣、智慧與無畏。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 搏一搏，單車變摩托？去年第四季，本港有超過6萬名15至39歲青年失業，失業率為百分之48。有人被裁，趁後生開咖啡店自己做老闆。有年輕人就憑一門手藝，膽粗粗開公司，希望賺取第一桶金。亦有人搏過之後，選擇了另一條路。這個世代，年輕人的選擇多了，創業又是否一條新出路？創業路上又會遇到甚麼困難？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 復活節假期有沙灘舉辦尋蛋活動，可是天公不造美致活動取消。家長不滿主辦方不延期不退款的安排，即使獲贈禮品包，相關安排亦混亂！有旅行社推出廣東省盲盒團，團友參與卻坐車不斷，而且要配合旅行社的推廣片段拍攝，大嘆中伏！事主收借貸推銷電話，覺利息相宜而答應借五萬，對方卻三度索取費用作抵押，而且相關費用多於五萬？攝製隊致電該「職員」及相關銀行了解，終發現……劉佩玥於上集《中年好聲音4》遭淘汰，有何感言想說？

programme.title: 香港何濟公止痛退熱散呈獻：中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 「黑白榮耀換位賽」迎來終局之戰，上集科亞高巴成功「奪位」，本集「下弦黑隊」五位成員亦全力出擊，務求將「上弦白隊」的選手拉下「榮耀寶座」，究竟還有誰人能逆襲得手？這場除了會有兩人要被淘汰外，還會公佈一連三集「黑白榮耀」篇章中，最終脫穎而出，獲頒MVP殊榮的歌者。

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 一部劇集《那些我愛過的人》，讓黃翠如、陳自瑤、連詩雅結成好友閨密團，皆因當年拍攝時大家都陷於低谷，互相扶持至今。各自考古三人的過往片段，自瑤藉《四葉草》喚回與「天王」合作記憶；詩雅重溫跟丈夫陳家樂初相識；但翠如嫌節目組只重播蕭正楠在頒獎禮公佈婚訊一刻太沒心思，還自揭當天的「不情願」？阿蕭、家樂拍片大讚妻子的好，自瑤卻提醒兩位好姊妹，勿只關注下一代而忽略自己！為十年後的對方寫信，自瑤竟遲遲未能動筆？

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 胡美貽與鼎爺品嚐得獎新派上海菜，包括菌皇龍蝦球、蟹粉鍋巴，以及搭配牛肉叉燒的白松露和牛盒，滿是驚喜滋味。居港日本人帶何泳芍享用正宗日式漢堡扒，可細嚐原味、配蘿蔔蓉加柚子醋，以及搭配生雞蛋等三種吃法。食評家劉晉帶伍倩彤造訪手工意粉店，店主以祖傳食譜炮製番紅花意式燉飯、帕馬火腿餡意大利餃等「私房菜」，風味獨特。將軍澳某街市內的小食街，網羅包含自製魚腐及炸醬的特色米線、越式魷魚粒蝦餅等美食，各具滋味。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
叠影狙擊#14粵PG
programme.desc: 曉晨以天齊可能需要換肺為由，請文諾幫忙聯繫教授；晟杰調查Momo時找到為她做過墮胎手術的無牌醫生，沒想到這人竟是教授的中間人。曉晨和文諾假扮情侶，教授提出要文諾親自交樣本，晟杰率下屬埋伏，怎料抓到的竟是…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 復活節假期有沙灘舉辦尋蛋活動，可是天公不造美致活動取消。家長不滿主辦方不延期不退款的安排，即使獲贈禮品包，相關安排亦混亂！有旅行社推出廣東省盲盒團，團友參與卻坐車不斷，而且要配合旅行社的推廣片段拍攝，大嘆中伏！事主收借貸推銷電話，覺利息相宜而答應借五萬，對方卻三度索取費用作抵押，而且相關費用多於五萬？攝製隊致電該「職員」及相關銀行了解，終發現……劉佩玥於上集《中年好聲音4》遭淘汰，有何感言想說？

programme.title: 隨懿深度行粵
programme.desc: 怡保「芯」度行啟程，黎諾懿相約首集嘉賓李佳芯遊二奶巷掃街，還找到數年前與店家的合照？百年藥材店轉型茶室，兩人獲老闆招待，細味茶文化。木工廠成小朋友樂園，達人手製木造玩具送給大家！佳芯重拾童趣，也意外顯露「老靈魂」？坐小船穿過山洞，迎來世外桃源般的鏡湖秘景，用心感受大自然的純粹。佳芯歎白咖啡順道學拉茶啡，諾懿卻彈到二樓「食花生」；咖央多士一啖一牛油，好邪惡！接着深入鄉郊的榴槤樹屋，享受片刻恬靜時光。

programme.title: 隨懿深度行粵
programme.desc: 嘉賓劉穎鏇初次踏足馬來西亞，想瘋狂歎美食，卻被帶到羅京森林……尋找「世界最大之花」大王花，諾懿背起穎鏇涉水渡河，說好的悠閒之旅呢？金馬崙高原是避暑勝地，穎鏇體驗餵羊與趕羊，卻遭無視？諾懿更被草泥馬口水突襲！走進夢幻花海打卡，再DIY微型生態盆栽，好療癒！豪華營地內的全透明「水晶房」，觀星住宿之選。嚐過士多啤梨雞飯後，二人行逛夜市感受地道風情。返回營區繼續食，好友圍爐自製番薯糖水，回顧旅程深刻點滴。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 要製作甜而不膩的甜品，除了食材份量控制要精準，還講求甜品師靈敏的味覺，從而配搭出最佳口味。阿古(古嘉俊)今次示範的「焦糖蘋果牛奶朱古力蛋糕」，透過微酸的青蘋果中和焦糖慕絲的甜膩，還運用青蘋果蓉的爽脆質感，與香滑慕絲形成有趣的口感對比。青蘋果蓉需事前混入肉桂粉醃製發酵，並經過一整晚時間的冷藏步驟，水果的清甜會否因而流失？今集請來彭慧中一同參與示範，到底她的甜美外表，會否令到阿古在控制甜度方面失預算？

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 婭溦、糖妹要於旅程中來趟閨密活動，在網上預約街頭攝影師隨行街拍，誓要留下珍貴回憶！來到百年歷史大樓秘景餐廳，俯瞰外灘景致，並在魔都最美陽台留影，另會品嚐精緻西餐。又是嚐辣專家婭㵟帶路，挑戰熱辣辣「麻辣燙」！私心揀選鵪鶉蛋、平菇、萵筍和蛋餃等美味食物拌吃，兩位吃貨把近一整盤辣菜下肚，夠豪邁。入夜，終於到了旅途最終站，二人體驗天台夜光Glamping，難得於浪漫星空下靜靜觀賞電影，盡訴心中情。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 適逢復活節長假期，6號教大家自製鹹蛋；又把西蘭花莖切片，分別加入柚子味噌、陳醋醃製，成品更得肥媽好評。阿媽亦特意奉上全蛋宴，她由健康出發，以刀削麵代替油分偏高的河粉，炮製出「七彩炒刀削麵」。「三色蒸蛋」是家常小菜，但要蒸出嫩滑靚蛋也有秘訣，蛋與水的比例怎樣？紫洋蔥含豐富花青素，連同冬菇等配料拌進香脆可口的「煎蛋餅」中，吃出肉餅口感！肥媽還將傳統甜品「水蒸蛋糕」的配方改良，「減甜」迎合健康生活態度。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 有指多吃咖喱，可助腦部延緩退化。肥媽精通環球美食，這次特意準備了印度咖喱菜式，讓地道風味發揮食療價值。肥媽為「鷹嘴豆餅」加入燕麥，創新配搭有助消減色素與油分。「炸餅」期間，「百厭」6號不依烹調指示，即令阿媽「發火」。另一道「印度素咖喱」，食材份量經過重新調配，貼近港人口味。「牛油雞」用希臘乳酪醃製再焗，入口軟腍。「印度咖喱角」的餡料以補腦黃薑粉製作，肥媽還加入印度酥油原味，香脆有益「無得輸」！

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼離開墨西哥，進入危地馬拉叢林探險。他們開車深入帕卡亞火山國家公園，游繩降下140呎的瀑布。然後去彈奏馬林巴琴，輕鬆一番。最後去阿蒂特蘭自然保護區，嘗試刺激的高空單車。

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼去馬拿瓜市的東方市場觀光。這是中美洲最大市場，面積超過五平方公里，有五萬攤檔，每天有十萬人次到訪。他們又去和棒球隊一起操練，爭取在職業比賽投出第一球。最後更勇闖活火山。

programme.title: 同屋企人去旅行粵
programme.desc: 林溥來和太太關宛珊帶上仔仔一家三口去旅行，首站來到位於廣州的室內滑雪場。兩大一小在那裡玩得不亦樂乎，冰滑梯更讓仔仔要求一玩再玩！廣州荔灣的艇仔粥遠近馳名，林氏一家當然要登艇享用這道正宗美食。旅程第二天前往清遠的靜山湖。這是一個生態園區，除了可餵飼多種動物之外，大家還可泛舟湖上，三口子更開心地在船上唱歌。廣州的珠海區有一個打卡熱點，不少壁畫都很漂亮。區內還有一個「溜娃」好地方，是怎麼一回事？

programme.title: 同屋企人去旅行粵
programme.desc: 溥來三口之家前往佛山的主題樂園，踏上玻璃吊橋，想不到最害怕的竟是宛珊。園內還有高空飛索、彩虹滑道，讓兩位大人玩得暢快。享用瀨粉美食後，仔仔漸入夢鄉，林爸爸、林媽媽把臂遊花田，回憶起初相識的動人畫面。轉往肇慶除了品嚐當地的裹蒸糭，林氏還體驗親子包糭樂。遊覽七星岩後，一家人於雨中浪漫用餐，怎料宛珊投訴老公絕少送花，溥來會如何解圍？溥來瞞着宛珊製作一本愛情回憶錄，但原來愛妻亦為他準備了驚喜……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#69粵
programme.desc: 義與情因德安鬧翻，安欲充當和事佬，義不領情。情在公司偷拍義責罵下屬的「惡行」，拿回家欲借家人壓力迫義改過，但家人卻盛讚義公私分明。情不斷和安煲電話粥，令義認為安的刻意接近，實有不可告人的秘密。

programme.title: 尚食#9粵普
programme.desc: 尚食局和尚膳監在皇家除夕宴上都會較量一番，子衿負責最後幾道菜，當知道尚膳監最後一道菜是福壽全三事，子衿最後利用蟹醬做出汆大甲來應對；瞻基把圖謀不軌的黨羽帶上，並指他們密謀毒害皇上，廢太子，擁立趙王。

programme.title: 香港本色粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 祭祖和拜神，雖然意義不同，但同樣展現出華人社會對祖先及神明的尊敬。「食山頭」是部分新界元朗宗族帶同生豬祭品祭祖後，就地煮成盆菜並即時享用的習俗。節目隨「山頭大廚」鄧聯興走上山頭，直擊由起灶烹製，到「打盆」的過程。為何長洲北帝廟中的北帝像沒有鬍鬚？廟祝龐寧講述與北帝有關的傳說。作為外來人的龍獅團負責人曾家明，何以會對長洲「北帝寶誕」不遺餘力？長洲居民會預備甚麼活動慶祝北帝誕？

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺、阿譚繼續遊走塔門，獲漁販推薦「有春」瀨尿蝦乾，味道特別甘香。將瀨尿蝦乾先浸軟後蒸熟，能減少腥味。鹹魚與肉餅是「最佳拍檔」，加入瀨尿蝦乾同煮更添滋味！鼎爺接着炮製「風沙椒鹽泥鯭」，還特意把陳皮炸香，帶來怎樣的風味？他又提醒剪泥鯭時要小心，慎防刺破內臟。將海鮮與醃菜同煮，有助提升鮮味。「酸菜桂花魚」一般會用醋來增加酸味，但少不免帶有澀味，鼎爺這次改用檸檬代替，還加入紥仔菜、大豆芽取鹹味和甜味。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 牙齦萎縮據悉有年輕化趨勢，除了牙周病、糖尿病等病理因素，不當使用電動牙刷亦可能導致？牙醫講解如何透過觀察自我檢測牙齒狀況，並帶來刷牙注意事項。他提醒牙齦一旦萎縮就不可逆轉，定期洗牙、使用牙線都是預防關鍵。物理治療師指出，手機是都市人肌肉痠痛的主要「元兇」，不少人會透過按摩舒緩。因應繁忙生活，「快速按摩」應運而生。對於這種新興的按摩方式，嘉賓提出專業看法。「睇餸食飯」，營養師陳國賓示範「茄子煮魚」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 早起的鳥兒有美食！祖藍於凌晨三點走入市場，嚐味「一條龍」的鮮宰豬肉麵，肉檔檔主推介的豬板筋有何特別？汕頭有數百間腸粉店，祖藍在地朋友推介的一間，牛肉腸粉夠薄皮夠晶瑩通透，餡料更有番茄再添驚喜！重點是腸粉由石磨機磨出米漿。舊城區人情味特別濃，祖藍帶來魚蛋，為社區飯堂「加餸」兼做義工派飯，而一位拾荒叔叔的無私捐獻故事，盡顯關顧鄰里的善意。旅程吃過甚多美食，一於喝杯潮汕涼茶舒解熱毒，怕苦者還有爽甜選擇？

programme.title: 五味人生#1粵PG
programme.desc: 老千馬永禎替惡霸丁大力任幫賭，其同伴利是妹則扮作滿州格格在火車上與大力對賭，永禎不斷提醒大力，格格有秘寶可作抵押。最後力大敗時卻發現永禎二人已乘亂逃去。連雙春找好友兼大廚梁九妹一起到廟宇上頭炷香，望亡夫的喜相逢酒家生意好轉。雙春和奶奶關老太吃早餐時，神智有問題的大太太汪若嵐盛裝出現，想嚇「母親」雙春。利是妹和永禎扮作「南天王」隨員來到佼佼鎮，在客棧騙吃騙喝，閒逛時走進了喜相逢，因此與雙春結下仇怨。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: TRIGGER的演唱會大收旺場，連龍之介也有了鬥志要成為日本第一。電視和雜誌依然不敢提及TRIGGER，大和和三月於是在直播節目上借機會提起。後來轉播Re:vale演唱會的時候，TRIGGER赫然出現，在台上為兩人伴舞。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 匹克球近年在香港越趨流行，不少人樂於參與。這回「Kids’ Notes」請來匹克球教練受訪，助大家提升技術。教練指，匹克球運動員要具備高度專注力與耐性，因此需針對反應、體能等訓練。他提醒運動前的熱身，及運動後的拉伸同樣重要，可有效降低受傷風險，並即場示範適合在家中進行的訓練動作。教練亦細談有志者可成為匹克球教練的途徑，並提到亞洲人在這項運動似乎擁有一定優勢。本集另會播放AI生成動畫《下金蛋的鵝》。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 小夫爸爸的朋友成金嘲諷大雄缺乏藝術素養，多啦A夢於是借出「延續噴霧」，讓大雄可以看到名畫的後續。胖虎把比賽落敗的責任歸咎大雄，勒令進行棒球對決，多啦A夢教大雄用「培育手巾」培育自己的棒球。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 黃竹坑站配套完善，附近樓齡較舊二手屋苑，入場價較低，吸引哪一類買家？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2779粵
programme.desc: 上班繁忙時段，接龍大堂人滿為患，僅一部升降機難以應付人流。璟風提議興建新大堂，敢威因耗資龐大而否決。力蓮嘲笑璟風，還自言可說服敢威，果然成功促成興建新大堂。力蓮看似贏得漂亮一仗，怎料發現敢威贊成興建新大堂原來另有隱情，遂感不忿。應對流年情況，力蓮「眷顧」璟風，設法為他催運擋煞，獲敢威同意。璟風苦不堪言，最終知悉力蓮真正用意。力蓮發現璟風有所行動，懷疑他欲「搞破壞」令她行衰運，詎料……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#6粵PG
programme.desc: 「少女殺嬰案」中，思義於惠知的啟發下，發現案件背後的殘忍真相。思義不解被告珊珊的背後動機，找惠知討論法律意見……惠知審理「碰瓷案」，最終從蛛絲馬跡中發現真相……邵文意外看到惠知檢視勵梅的資料，他雖表面冷漠，心中仍受打擊。另一邊廂，成彬的補習老師Lydia突然不知所蹤，而她最後見的人正是成彬。惠知、偉迪落力尋找Lydia失蹤的線索……淑樺隱隱覺得不安，成彬卻淡定地主動配合警方的調查，毫無破綻……

programme.title: 大生意人#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 流犯古平原在寧古塔替管帶徐三做事，暗助馬幫的常四離開，平原被徐三射傷為常四所救，施計躲過徐三追捕，還令他免職。平原隨常四回平遙城，常四遭王天貴算計，面臨以宅院抵債，科爾沁鬧馬瘟要人送藥，平原靈機一動。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 小食「豬油盒」據說由清朝宮廷流落民間，現時可在甘肅的天水市吃到。當地用的卻非炸豬油，而是來自煮滷肉的水油？家鋌師傅用自家製「豬油渣」炒飯，為中和油膩感，也會配搭炸羽衣甘藍。要炒出靚飯，有甚麼秘訣？在陝西西安市，有一款被指從唐朝流傳的古早美食「葫蘆頭泡饃」，以足料湯底熬製，饃則要「九死一生」，此話何解？世韜師傅受啟發下，燜煮出多重味道的「鹹菜豬肚湯」，配上銀絲卷撕碎浸湯進食，主持嚐吃後直言過癮！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#39粵
programme.desc: 假嬴政以蕞城失守向少龍問罪，此時不韋率兵到來捉拿少龍指他與李牧私通。少龍向不韋透露假嬴政一事，不韋深夜訪假嬴政後，剛好撞見娘蓉欲偷天牢符印，將計就計。少龍與嫪毐談條件，若歸還琴清則確保大王平安。不韋成功殺假嬴政，少龍暗中將真嬴政交給嫪毐，廷芳突然出現殺嫪毐。嫪毐挾持廷芳，少龍驚悉廷芳曾被姦污及嫪毐殺趙倩，悲憤交集。不韋宣佈嬴政遇刺身亡，大將蒙傲推舉不韋當大王時，嬴政突然出現，揭穿不韋的篡位奸計。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 五味人生#1粵PG
programme.desc: 老千馬永禎替惡霸丁大力任幫賭，其同伴利是妹則扮作滿州格格在火車上與大力對賭，永禎不斷提醒大力，格格有秘寶可作抵押。最後力大敗時卻發現永禎二人已乘亂逃去。連雙春找好友兼大廚梁九妹一起到廟宇上頭炷香，望亡夫的喜相逢酒家生意好轉。雙春和奶奶關老太吃早餐時，神智有問題的大太太汪若嵐盛裝出現，想嚇「母親」雙春。利是妹和永禎扮作「南天王」隨員來到佼佼鎮，在客棧騙吃騙喝，閒逛時走進了喜相逢，因此與雙春結下仇怨。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#69粵
programme.desc: 義與情因德安鬧翻，安欲充當和事佬，義不領情。情在公司偷拍義責罵下屬的「惡行」，拿回家欲借家人壓力迫義改過，但家人卻盛讚義公私分明。情不斷和安煲電話粥，令義認為安的刻意接近，實有不可告人的秘密。

programme.title: 尚食#9粵普
programme.desc: 尚食局和尚膳監在皇家除夕宴上都會較量一番，子衿負責最後幾道菜，當知道尚膳監最後一道菜是福壽全三事，子衿最後利用蟹醬做出汆大甲來應對；瞻基把圖謀不軌的黨羽帶上，並指他們密謀毒害皇上，廢太子，擁立趙王。

programme.title: 同屋企人去旅行粵
programme.desc: 袁偉豪與太太張寶兒接力出行，「跟團」遊潮汕。潮州人愛喝功夫茶，袁生、袁太也要感受茶道魅力，怎料引發兩口子的小吵鬧情趣。二人又體驗吃茶聽戲觀賞潮劇，還解鎖人生的打賞成就。品嚐潮州地道特色粿品，偉豪何以自認食家？好勝寶兒對壘偷步偉豪，手做紅桃粿比拼結果如何？夜遊汕頭小公園，「大糖蔥薄餅 」令人找回兒時回憶；偉豪竟斗膽在老婆面前「撩女仔」！回到酒店，兩人分享旅行喜好，偉豪還藉機向愛妻「賣口乖」。

programme.title: 同屋企人去旅行粵
programme.desc: 偉豪駕駛電單車載寶兒欣賞南澳島沿岸風光，並到訪文青咖啡店。獅頭鵝是潮汕名物，袁氏伉儷享用一席全鵝宴，一個鵝頭就逾千元！「打冷」亦是潮遊不可錯過的行程，寶兒化身賢內助為丈夫剝蝦殼。袁生、袁太來到活化自百年建築的茶樓飲早茶，再由旅遊達人帶路享用潮州私房菜，花膠、鮑魚等名貴菜式放滿一桌。走在汕尾的步道上，寶兒提出對望四分鐘的挑戰。怎料望着望着，她卻流下淚水，這時偉豪拿出一份記錄了兩人滿滿回憶的禮物……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#70粵
programme.desc: 義要揭發安殺人證據，但「藏屍皮箱」只是收藏大的芒果，安的神秘舉動只為話劇表演。眾人決定替安的家大翻新，更送出名貴電器以表陪罪。義接到大客需為員工投保的消息，立即命安等撰寫計劃書，但安竟偷拍下機密資料。

programme.title: 尚食#10粵普
programme.desc: 孟尚食被太子妃免去職位，她不明白王司膳為何落井下石，胡司膳道出原因；孟紫澐成為雜役，被月華批評她不知尊卑；太孫妃知道和太孫和子衿琴簫合奏，特地讓子衿送膳食及陪下棋，瞭解她的為人。

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 中國人愛「好意頭」，在農曆新年均喜愛貼上揮春、剪紙等傳統裝飾。隨着科技進步，人手書寫的揮春逐漸被電腦打印取代，但書法家「華戈」仍堅持即席揮毫。華戈曾為不少電影、廣告等題字，大家認得哪些是他的手筆嗎？看似簡單的剪紙，原來隱藏着不少奧妙之處。剪紙藝術家李云俠示範剪羊時，何以會多剪一個風車作花紋？除了賀年裝飾，汕尾的「菜茶」亦被列入非物質文化遺產清單，香港廣東汕尾市同鄉總會會長詳述與菜茶有關的歷史。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 蟶子到！兩斤蟶子可怎樣烹調？鼎爺把部份蟶子開邊，連同冬瓜滾湯，剩下的蟶子原隻下鑊炒，再搭配原粒豉椒，鮮味昇華。準備好透明瓶子，還有預留兩日時間，一同醃豆角。把豆角繞着辣椒，外表夠特別，味道方面為何又要青檸又要醋，再加冰糖及粗鹽？話梅酸豆角醃法又怎樣？醃豆角除了單獨作小吃，還可融入一盆材料豐富的蟹肉冷麵，品嚐者必定大感滿足。青瓜竟然只要外皮不要肉？有人愛在冷麵上同時加麻醬及花生醬，阿爺卻只偏好麻醬！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 癌症是香港頭號殺手，幸而治療方法越來越成熟，而放射治療亦分遠、近？臨床腫瘤科醫生細說二者分別。此外，標靶放射治療是如何做到精準打擊癌細胞？入行五十載的文雪兒到臨，暢談深刻點滴。雪兒姐已是五個外孫的婆婆，現時其生活作息怎樣？其實雪兒姐的人生也曾遇過一些波浪，包括得悉自己患上乳癌，她作為「過來人」訴說經歷和當時心境，藉以鼓勵正受挫折的人士。「睇餸食飯」，李偉強師傅巧製創意菜式「焦糖菠蘿咖啡排骨」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 「海上絲綢之路」三大港口之一的樟木古港，是粵東一個重要港口，祖藍這集在所屬的澄海區探尋美食。首站是每碗只售十元人民幣的豬腳飯，老闆堅持選豬腳定要夠新鮮，也夠信心推薦不嫌製作「麻煩」的豬腳趾，滷肉最少要花三小時，究竟有多滋味？還建議加五元配蠔仔湯，特別解膩！講起解膩，以五穀雜糧與刨冰奇妙融合的冰粥，想必可做到清爽又解暑。到訪當地祠堂，與某大家庭一起「吃桌」，祖藍的二嬸還從東莞前來，一齊品嚐豐富宴席！

programme.title: 五味人生#2粵
programme.desc: 雙春被若嵐襲擊，九妹替她不值，令雙春憶起因何嫁入關家……雙春被批發海鮮的貨商追欠款，只得請求延期。永禎被旅館老闆懷疑身分，正盤算另覓居所時，聽到有錢人任老闆將回鎮祭祖，於是在鎮長前冒認任老闆的代理人。同是經營酒樓的關照仁與關照義與海鮮貨商見面，想藉機讓雙春出賣酒樓；若嵐意外發現雙春收藏的金器首飾……雙春發現若嵐將自己的金器變賣後買入一堆無用的東西，不禁責罵若嵐；雙春為取回西服，當街打暈永禎……

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: TRIGGER在 Next Re:vale前監製暗中幫助下，逐漸獲得電視台工作。IDOLiSH7和Re:vale與電視台人員開會共享《Friends Day》細節，事後移師百家裡進行內部會議，就了的破壞行動商討對策。百千萬三人喝酒談天，分享各自內心的想法。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 過往都由代為管理零食廠的話事人主理「廠長話」遊戲，蚌蚌公主這次將考官重任讓給團長Tiffany姐姐。Tiffany發出連串指令，某小兵於熱身賽三次出錯，到正式淘汰賽可會令人刮目相看？推地壺收集食材任務，啫喱隊、布甸隊對力度的控制似有不少差距。雙方合共收集到四款食材，蚌蚌公主仍對兩隊的表現感滿意。在「溶化之橋」上運送雪糕球不容易，有小兵踏出第三步就已弄跌雪糕。兩隊都採取先進取後保守的策略，成績如何？

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵���
programme.desc: 五十嵐指出蜻蛉打的並非高爾夫球，因她沒感受過壓力。五十嵐嘗試讓蜻蛉體會何謂壓力，最後反而認輸，決家讓她保留真我。五十嵐想帶蜻蛉離開島上，他知道一般方法行不通，決定轉換思考方式。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 血友病是一種遺傳性凝血功能障礙疾病，因缺乏某類型凝血因子，導致受傷後血液不易凝固、長時間出血，或關節、肌肉自發性出血。該病多數女性為基因攜帶者，但極少發病，主要以影響男性為主。現時治療方法，主要是依靠終身定期或按需要時，靜脈注射缺失的凝血因子濃縮物，以防止受傷流血不止以及嚴重的關節病變。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2780粵
programme.desc: 吳旺達要向某國購置糧食，城安奉命陪同牙斬斬會見該國大使，卻因他厭惡該國「國菜」三色豆而得罪對方。為了拯救國民，城安務要克服對三色豆的「恐懼」。凌凌、璟風等人嘗試協助，卻未見成效。原來城安於童年極愛吃三色豆；尚善設法追查城安對此改變的原因，卻有意想不到的發現，並必須解開他吃不了三色豆的「心結」，過程令城安苦不堪言。其後，城安與牙斬斬再次會見大使，城安不得不品嚐三色豆大餐……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#7粵PG
programme.desc: 成彬被淑樺送離香港，加上警方連日搜索不果，Lydia的失蹤成為懸案。女學生文靜宜用美工刀割傷男教師張一匯，被控傷人，但她聲稱一匯企圖非禮。事件已導致一匯被停職、女友與他分手；惠知卻對兩名同學的證言有所懷疑，破天荒要求檢控官雅晴傳召全班三十名同學作證，終查明背後還另有隱情……接連的少年案件真相，思義有所反思，並希望修補與兒子洪知行的關係。少年趙世孝與樓宇住客口角後懷恨，為泄心頭之憤，竟然放火燒屋！

programme.title: 大生意人#2粵普
programme.desc: 平原擅自接了送藥材去科爾沁的生意，好讓常四有錢還債；常四雖擔心當地正在打仗，卻逼於無奈接受。送藥材大隊經過黑水沼時玉兒不慎墮進沼澤，平原奮勇拯救。大隊抵達科爾沁，漢隆一直拖延給錢，常四和平原感到有詐…

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 四川人會把鹹蛋開洞釀入糯米，製成地道美食糯米蛋，還曾風行全國。世韜師傅亦以糯米飯為材料，並融入廣東春卷特色，帶來變奏版菜式「脆皮糯米飯」。外層酥脆、內裡軟糯，再加上臘味、冬菇、瑤柱等惹味配料，層次豐富。北方人愛吃餃子，遼寧作為東北三省之一，當地人更以盛產的海腸、海膽入饌，製成餃子的餡料。紫欣以此做參考，結合西式烹調技巧，送上「海膽帶子意大利餃子」。這道菜令永權不顧儀態試食，滋味程度可想而知。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#40粵
programme.desc: (大結局)王翦倒戈，嬴政重掌大權，故意講出自己真正身分，不韋險被氣死，嬴政再賜飲毒酒，不韋死不瞑目。嬴政將朱姬的兒子吊在廣場引嫪毐回來，再在朱二人面前殺其子，少龍欲救無從。廷芳自覺配不上少龍，留書出走，少龍向廷芳剖白愛意。嬴政以一半江山試探少龍，少龍不為所動。少龍帶二女等離開咸陽城，赫見王翦率兵攔阻。少龍等返回烏家堡，即接報嬴政親率大軍來捉少龍，少龍吩咐眾人躲進趙雅的衣冠塚，自己則與嬴政同歸於盡。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.desc: 「海上絲綢之路」三大港口之一的樟木古港，是粵東一個重要港口，祖藍這集在所屬的澄海區探尋美食。首站是每碗只售十元人民幣的豬腳飯，老闆堅持選豬腳定要夠新鮮，也夠信心推薦不嫌製作「麻煩」的豬腳趾，滷肉最少要花三小時，究竟有多滋味？還建議加五元配蠔仔湯，特別解膩！講起解膩，以五穀雜糧與刨冰奇妙融合的冰粥，想必可做到清爽又解暑。到訪當地祠堂，與某大家庭一起「吃桌」，祖藍的二嬸還從東莞前來，一齊品嚐豐富宴席！

programme.title: 五味人生#2粵
programme.desc: 雙春被若嵐襲擊，九妹替她不值，令雙春憶起因何嫁入關家……雙春被批發海鮮的貨商追欠款，只得請求延期。永禎被旅館老闆懷疑身分，正盤算另覓居所時，聽到有錢人任老闆將回鎮祭祖，於是在鎮長前冒認任老闆的代理人。同是經營酒樓的關照仁與關照義與海鮮貨商見面，想藉機讓雙春出賣酒樓；若嵐意外發現雙春收藏的金器首飾……雙春發現若嵐將自己的金器變賣後買入一堆無用的東西，不禁責罵若嵐；雙春為取回西服，當街打暈永禎……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#70粵
programme.desc: 義要揭發安殺人證據，但「藏屍皮箱」只是收藏大的芒果，安的神秘舉動只為話劇表演。眾人決定替安的家大翻新，更送出名貴電器以表陪罪。義接到大客需為員工投保的消息，立即命安等撰寫計劃書，但安竟偷拍下機密資料。

programme.title: 尚食#10粵普
programme.desc: 孟尚食被太子妃免去職位，她不明白王司膳為何落井下石，胡司膳道出原因；孟紫澐成為雜役，被月華批評她不知尊卑；太孫妃知道和太孫和子衿琴簫合奏，特地讓子衿送膳食及陪下棋，瞭解她的為人。

programme.title: 我係小廚神粵
programme.desc: 要將平凡食材變成美饌，絕對是考驗烹飪功力，今集七位候選小廚神先以蛋為主要食材炮製第一道菜式；再在午餐肉、吞拿魚、蟹肉、香腸、蜆肉等七款罐頭食品中抽籤，並煮出第二道菜式，到底誰能晉級決賽成為最後兩強？

programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你(完)
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.title: Everybody Loves a Moose
programme.desc: An oddball buddy series between an over ambitious boy, Jack and his pal Moose, a melodramatic self-confessed expert in everything. Except he isn't! programme.title: Tom's Car Wash

programme.title: Eliot Kid

programme.title: Pumpkin Reports

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! programme.title: The Little Comrade
programme.desc: During Stalinist tyranny, 6-year-old Leelo’s mother is sent to a prison camp. Haunted by her mother’s last words telling her to be a good kid, Leelo vows to be on her best behaviour in the hope that it will bring her mother back.

programme.title: Man And A Baby
programme.desc: Dad (Antti) is left alone with a newborn after the mom (Pia) decides motherhood is not her thing. Single dad tries to survive alone in "women's world" and keep the baby and himself alive.

programme.title: A Murder Of Crows Jealousy
programme.desc: Inspector Bruhl is investigating the abduction of a young boy from a playground, until evidence suggests that the boy doesn’t exist at all. Is he a figment of the alleged mother’s fractured reality, or are answers buried in her traumatic past?

programme.title: Run Up!
programme.desc: After a life-altering accident shatters her dreams, Elodie, a young hiker turned paraplegic, discovers the power of wheelchair sports. With the help of her trainer Isabelle, she is able to awaken from her lethargy and recognize true victories in life.

programme.title: Open Door
programme.desc: Rudina embarks on a road trip with her pregnant sister Elma back to their Albanian hometown. However, Elma is unmarried, and they need to find someone to play the part of her husband in order not to anger their traditional father.

programme.title: The Peace And Love Process
programme.desc: Marie and Simon, a couple with two children, are deeply in love despite constant fights in their paired life. To save their marriage, they come up with a chart of Ten Rules to seek love and peace.

programme.title: Nick-Off Duty
programme.desc: When Lenny sets off on a mission to avenge her mother’s murder, she finds herself in trouble with the Russian mob and an underground organ harvesting ring. Her father, Hamburg cop Nick and his partner must race against the clock to rescue her.

programme.title: Oskar & Lilli: Where No One Knows Us
programme.desc: Chechen siblings Oskar and Lilli face deportation from Austria but are separated in foster care after their mother’s suicide attempt. Meeting in secret, the siblings hold onto hope that they will reunite as a family someday.

programme.title: To Kill A Mongolian Horse
programme.desc: Saina, a herdsman by day and horseback performer by night, clings to his heritage on the wintry steppes of Inner Mongolia, as he’s forced to confront the crumbling of the world he once knew.

programme.title: Lost In Marseille
programme.desc: Bruno, a stay-at-home father of two, gets back in touch with his masculinity when his wife is kidnapped in Marseille. Instead of the planned holiday on the Côte d'Azur, Bruno gets deeper and deeper into an intrigue, pursued by police and mafia.

programme.title: The Little Comrade
programme.desc: During Stalinist tyranny, 6-year-old Leelo’s mother is sent to a prison camp. Haunted by her mother’s last words telling her to be a good kid, Leelo vows to be on her best behaviour in the hope that it will bring her mother back.

programme.title: The Intangible Joy of Love
programme.desc: When the notorious liar Greta unexpectedly kisses the lonesome butcher Alex on the neck at a bus stop, both are unaware that this chance encounter is exactly what they have been missing in their lives

programme.title: With or Without you
programme.desc: A young woman, her free-spirited mother and a West African man find themselves on an unexpected road trip that leads to emotional transformation.

programme.title: Khutulun: The Wrestling Princess

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Up Down, Down Up
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po drive the Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup where they discover the Tubby Uppy Downy. They have fun going up down, down up!

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S3) - Socks
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'socks' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! We see lots of different socks - summer socks, cosy socks, toes-y socks and even super socks!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S3) - Hiccups
programme.desc: Messy's hiccups cause a landslide while he is out on a nature walk. Will he be able to find his way home? And will he ever stop hiccupping?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Mojo Drop the Ball
programme.desc: Preston needs to knock down his shed, and Mojo has the wrecking ball to do it. But first, Mojo and Bo have to get it all the way across town, which is harder than it sounds!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Smoochy Kiss
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. The Squirrels take an epic journey to give it back.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone who looks like Enid, only much too big. Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Mountain Gorillas, The Democratic Republic of the Congo
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to save a family of mountain gorillas from traps left by hunters and also from a sneezy Grandmaster Glitch's germs.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Dump
programme.desc: On a trip to the Dump, Dad claims he's the best at everything. But Bluey discovers that Dad's throwing out her old drawing and questions if he really is the best Dad in the world.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Mr Monkeyjocks
programme.desc: Dad thinks the kids have too many toys and suggests a chuck out. To save their beloved Mr Monkeyjocks from getting the chop, Bluey and Bingo must prove he is special.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Bedroom
programme.desc: Chilli and Bandit transform the old nursery into a new bedroom for Bluey. In the process, Bluey and Bingo amicably divide their belongings, but get absorbed by trading items and swapping notes at bedtime. Ultimately, when Bluey misses her sister, she asks to return to her old room.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Chilli sets up an obstacle course in the backyard, but Bluey is disheartened when Bandit turns it into a race and beats her. After cheating in a rematch, Bluey discovers the importance of training in order to improve her skills.

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures (S1) - Andy and the Common Octopus
programme.desc: Andy blasts off in his safari-sub to the coast of South Africa in search of an octopus.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Gloves
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie play a fun game of 'Wavey Wavey Snap' using some giant, silly gloves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Honey Badge
programme.desc: Duggee's made some delicious pancakes, but the clubhouse is out of honey. Time for the bees to get busy!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Tadpole Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has made a beautiful rock pool. The Squirrels spot the strangest things - dots with tails, wriggling around. What on earth are they? They are baby frogs - tadpoles!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Kite Badge
programme.desc: It's a very windy day and the squirrels want to play outside. What can they do? Duggee knows - he's flying his kite. The Squirrels set about making their own kites to fly.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Tower Bridge, London
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is visiting London and spots the perfect souvenir hat. But he's run out of pocket money, so he decides to earn some as a tour guide.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Panama Canal, Panama
programme.desc: Glitch sinks in the Panama Canal and needs saving... again.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - Crowning Around
programme.desc: Rajiv feels devastated when he loses his crown, thinking that it's the reason he is good at anything, but he soon learns that can still be really useful.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - The Mouse's Birthday
programme.desc: Sarah's hoping for a nice quiet birthday, but there's no chance once her friends arrive.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Ribbon Fall
programme.desc: The Ribbon Sisters invite Sarah and Duck to their favourite seasonal event in the park.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Dinosaur
programme.desc: The children want to make a big dinosaur model so they can learn all about it. They make such a huge dinosaur that they want to take it to the museum to be shown as an exhibit.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Kite
programme.desc: Stanley helps Little Woo and Seamus fly their new kite. It gets stuck up a tree and breaks. Using leaves and sticks, they build a better one, only for that to get stuck.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals (S1) - Penguins Live in Igloos
programme.desc: Rain, hail, sunshine, and making snow giraffes! The animals chat about everything they love about their favourite seasons.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Go Stargazing
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are having a sleepover. JoJo loves to look at the night sky, so Gran Gran suggests that they go stargazing in the garden. What can they spot in the night sky? Are there more constellations to find?

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Onesies
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tradies
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Granny Mobile
programme.desc: Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Traffic Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels begin a trip to the lake, but get stuck in a traffic jam!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Water Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels learn all about where water comes from, and their journey takes them from the sea and back to the kitchen sink and another drink of water. Wow! Water is amazing!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Ilulissat, Greenland
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch has travelled to Ilulissat in Greenland to show his teddy, Cuddles, the sights. But Cuddles ends up getting stuck in the snow!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Kiwi
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Kiwi performing Do the Kiwi Dance - if he manages to find someone to interview him first.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Coconut
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Coconut getting his moment in the limelight with his sea shanty Oh, the Big Waves - if he manages to overcome a little stage fright.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Undercover Tomato
programme.desc: Tomato paints himself green and goes undercover as a Mini Pea to discover how Evil Pea is firing them at Tato Tower. He makes an unexpected new Mini Pea friend.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Toy Aisle Trouble
programme.desc: Evil Pea takes all the toys in the supermarket for herself and the Cobs to play with. Supertato climbs a big wall of boxes to try and get the toys back.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Up Down, Down Up
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po drive the Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup where they discover the Tubby Uppy Downy. They have fun going up down, down up!

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government's secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor's ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after it is attacked by the Qing army and is badly wounded. He is handed over to the Qing soldiers by Fang as he mistakes Hong for a bandit. When Fang realizes his mistakes, he tries all ways to help Hong escape so that they can team up to fight the Qing army together.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness & innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness &amp;amp; innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper's daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, the adopted son of the Great Banner Sect leader, is hunted by the sect's rival for the secret to its hidden treasure. To uncover the truth, he journeys to an island seeking the "Empress of the Day", only to find her dead. There, he unexpectedly meets the sect's founder, the "Emperor of the Night", who reveals that he is Tie's biological father.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: A young business man marries a pretty and much sought-after young bride, not knowing that she carries the spirit of a girl raped by her uncle and murdered along with her parents. Justice must be done, and it ain't pretty!

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. Knowing Shan Bo died in despair, Ying Tai is in deep sorrow and kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.
